reviews.text: I had an amazing experience with Yeimi at the Dominican salon! She is incredibly professional, knowledgeable, and talented. She took the time to understand exactly what I wanted and did an amazing job with my hair. I absolutely loved the results! Highly recommend Yeimi if you’re looking for someone who truly knows how to make your hair look beautiful. 💕✨

After going almost two years without a haircut, I was honestly a little nervous, but Josmarie did an AMAZING job! She really listened to what I wanted, and I absolutely love how my cut came out. The layers and face-framing pieces are exactly what I was looking for. I was so relaxed and comfortable during my appointment that I had my eyes closed almost the entire time 😂. I’m so happy I found my new hairstylist! Thank you, Josmarie! 💕✨

I’ve being going to this salon for years and the minute Yeimy touched my hair I have never colored at home again! The best place to get color done and so much more!! 💗 won’t let anyone else touch my hair
